treats every descriptor field as optional json obj parse returns a bitmask of the fields it actually decoded and never fails on a missing one so a response that omits the sha256sum string leaves the corresponding const char in the zero initialised struct resp probe any boards struct resp probe some boards at null both metadata branches then computed sha256size strlen objects sha256sum 1 before any validation dereferencing that null pointer the sha256 hex digest size test that follows operates on a value the bad read has already produced and cannot prevent it the metadata is supplied entirely by the network peer probe cb accepts the datagram runs coap packet parse and copies the payload with no token matching and no cryptographic check with config updatehub dtls unset the default start coap client uses plain coap over udp on port 5683 with no peer authentication and resolves the server via unauthenticated dns so an on path attacker a dns spoofer or an off path attacker who wins the race with a forged source address can deliver the malformed metadata a probe response as simple as objects suffices and no user interaction is required because updatehub autohandler polls on config updatehub poll interval when config updatehub dtls y the trigger narrows to a malicious or compromised update server the primitive is a read at address zero not a write so the impact is availability only on targets where the low address range is unmapped or protected mmu based architectures builds with config null pointer exception detection dwt mpu pmp trustzone non secure images and socs such as nrf54l whose 0x0 0x400 window is unmapped the load faults and zephyr s default fatal handler halts the system giving a remotely re triggerable denial of service on every poll on classic cortex m targets where the vector table is readable at address zero the walk usually terminates immediately and the request is rejected by the length check so the outcome is configuration and soc dependent there is no memory write and the copied bytes are only compared against the locally computed image hash so there is no information disclosure channel the fix adds an explicit sha256sum null test that returns updatehub metadata error ahead of the strlen in both metadata branches debug builds config updatehub log level 4 still format the same pointers with s in a log dbg loop that runs before the new checks so that variant remains in debug configurations only

fullName: The OSDP Control Panel reply parser cp_decode_response() in subsys/mgmt/osdp/src/osdp_cp.c decodes replies from a Peripheral Device into a stack-allocated struct osdp_event.

for the reply keyppad and reply raw reply types the payload length is taken from the received frame and the only validation performed is that the declared length is self consistent with the number of payload bytes present in the frame because the attacker controls both the length field and the frame length that check imposes no bound and the subsequent memcpy writes into the fixed 64 byte data arrays of struct osdp event keypress struct osdp event cardread osdp event max datalen the sibling reply fmt handler in the same switch already carried the missing osdp event max datalen bound the defect is reached from cp process reply which reads bytes from the osdp rs 485 channel and passes them through osdp phy check packet and osdp phy decode packet before dispatching on the reply id triggering it requires config osdp with config osdp mode cp and an application event callback registered the normal control panel integration plus a frame carrying a correct som a valid crc 16 and a matching 2 bit sequence number all of which are computable or observable by anyone on the bus no check ties the reply id to the outstanding command so an oversized reply keyppad or reply raw is accepted as the answer to a routine cmd poll a malicious or compromised card reader or anyone with access to the rs 485 wiring can supply such a frame config osdp sc enabled only helps while a secure channel is active and a single unauthenticated frame carrying a bad mac causes sc deactivate after which plaintext replies are again accepted with the default config osdp uart buffer length of 256 roughly 180 bytes of fully attacker chosen data can be written past the end of the stack allocated event object over saved registers and the return address on typical cortex m and risc v frame layouts zephyr does not enable stack canaries by default the impact ranges from a hard crash of the access control panel to potential control flow hijack in the context of the osdp receive thread the fix adds an osdp event max datalen bound to both handlers capping each memcpy at the size of its destination
